subject: Interim manager coverage for Platform Core — approval & handover
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Interim manager coverage for Platform Core — approval & handover

Hi Evelyn & Vivek,

Heads-up: Lukas Meyer (Platform Core) will be on parental leave starting March 1 for ~8 weeks. We need to assign an interim manager for his direct reports and make sure his mid-year review (scheduled for Apr 10) is handled appropriately.

I propose Vivek step in as interim manager for the duration. Vivek and I discussed scope: he would be the official manager of record for performance reviews, 1:1s, and promotion/comp approval requests during the leave. No permanent title change intended.

Attached: manager_transition_form.pdf and updated_org_chart_v2.png.

Requests:
- HR sign-off to process the interim manager assignment in Workday and confirm whether any compensation/title paperwork is needed.
- Confirmation that Vivek will be authorized to submit the mid-year review on behalf of Lukas.
- Guidance on whether we should move the Apr 10 review or keep it and have Vivek complete it.

Can we get sign-off by end-of-day Wednesday (Feb 25)? Happy to set a quick 30-min sync if helpful.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Director, Platform
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0212
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interim manager coverage for Platform Core — approval & handover

Thanks for the context, Laura.

Quick notes from People Ops:
- For temporary assignments under 6 months we typically do not update title or comp automatically; we _do_ require a manager_transfer form so Workday reflects reporting lines during the absence.
- We need to confirm whether the interim manager will have budget sign-off or approval for comp actions (promotions/raises). If Vivek needs that authority, we will route to the VP for delegation temporarily.
- HR recommends keeping the Apr 10 mid-year review date. If Vivek prefers to postpone to allow for one full month of overlap/hand-off, we can document the change in Workday.

I've attached the HR checklist (hr_manager_transfer_checklist.docx) — please fill out the highlighted sections.

Two asks for you:
1) Laura/Vivek — fill the manager transfer form and confirm whether Vivek should have budget delegation.
2) Monica — please coordinate with Payroll if any admin adjustments are requested.

If helpful, Megan O'Neill (external HR consultant) can help expedite the Workday transactions — @Megan, looping you in.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 12:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interim manager coverage for Platform Core — approval & handover

Laura / Evelyn — I can take this on. No problem stepping in for the 8-week period. A few quick clarifying points:
- I will take ownership of the Apr 10 mid-year review unless HR prefers it postponed; if I run the review I will need Lukas's last 6 months' goal tracker and any previous calibration notes.
- I would like clarity on budget delegation: are we talking about ability to approve promotion/comp changes up to a certain band, or only to recommend?
- I'll need a 30–45 minute handoff with Laura to get up to speed on ongoing priorities and key stakeholder relationships.

I can make time Monday (Feb 23) or Tuesday morning for the handoff.

Thanks — Vivek
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interim manager coverage for Platform Core — approval & handover

On Fri, 20 Feb 2026 at 09:12 AM Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Heads-up: Lukas Meyer (Platform Core) will be on parental leave starting March 1 for ~8 weeks. We need to assign an interim manager for his direct reports and make sure his mid-year review (scheduled for Apr 10) is handled appropriately.

Thanks again everyone. Vivek — I'm attaching the handover notes and a short summary of the last 6 months that you'll need for the review (lukas_handover_notes.txt). Key bullets below for the review:
- Strengths: system design, on-call ownership for release pipeline, strong cross-team collaboration with Data infra.
- Areas to watch: scope creep on infra projects, needs clearer prioritization across OKRs.
- Open deliverables: rollout of deploy-gating (target mid-Apr), incident post-mortem for Feb outage (action items owned by Lukas).

Tentative asks for vote: keep the Apr 10 review date; authorize Vivek to submit the mid-year rating and narrative. No comp change requested at this time — LAURA requests HR keep comp unchanged unless a VP-level exception is required.

Proposed handoff meeting: Tue Feb 24, 10:00–10:45 PT (I'll send invite).

Laura Bennett
Director, Platform

Attachments referenced: lukas_handover_notes.txt
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Megan O'Neill <megan.oneill@peoplepartners.co>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interim manager coverage for Platform Core — approval & handover

All set — approved with conditions.

Summary of actions completed:
- People Ops will submit the Workday manager_transfer form to record Vivek as interim manager from 2026-03-01 to 2026-04-25.
- Compensation will remain unchanged per Laura's request; any comp action required while Lukas is on leave will need VP sign-off and a separate request routed through People Ops.
- Vivek is authorized to complete the Apr 10 mid-year review and submit ratings/narrative. HR will mark the review as completed by the interim manager in the system.
- I have routed the manager_transfer form for electronic signature — please sign via DocuSign: https://na.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123

Monica — please coordinate with Payroll to ensure no benefits or payroll changes are triggered by this temporary reporting update.

Megan — if you could help expedite the Workday ticket (WD-98321) that would be appreciated.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference
